subject: Dropbox and raster image errors in shinapps.io

messages.author: acb07455e19d07b5
messages.subject: Dropbox and raster image errors in shinapps.io
parts:
Hi everyone,

I created an R Shiny app which works in my R Studio console. It includes csv, raster, and shapefiles. I relocated these files to Drobox prior to running my app.R, and am now having issue with shinyapps.io connecting to Dropbox. I assume the "Shiny cannot use on-disk bookmarking" error is related to the app.R file still running from my C://? 

Code causing the errors:

library(shiny)     #interactive web interface
library(graphics)  #create graphs
library(rgdal)     #import shapefiles
library(raster)    #import rasters
library(leaflet)   #interactive web maps
library(rdrop2)    #read files from Dropbox

#save Dropbox authentification token
token <- drop_auth()
# Upload droptoken to your server
saveRDS(token, "droptoken.rds")
# read it back with readRDS
token <- readRDS("droptoken.rds")
# Then pass the token to each drop_ function
drop_acc(dtoken = token)


#REFERENCE GRAPHS
#import datasets
graphs = drop_read_csv("ShinyRiskMaps/graphs.csv", dtoken = token)
graphs$YR_1DEP = as.factor(graphs$YR_1DEP)

graphs2 = drop_read_csv("ShinyRiskMaps/graphsallot.csv", dtoken = token)
graphs2$REPRODUCED = as.factor(graphs2$REPRODUCED)

#import pack-scale map rasters
CATTLEcty = raster("ShinyRiskMaps/wacty40av3")
CATTLEallot = raster("ShinyRiskMaps/waalt40av3")

#import allotment shapefile
ALLOTmap = readOGR(dsn = "ShinyRiskMaps/allotshp/forecastallot.shp", layer = "forecastallot")

***************************************************************************************************************************************************************

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Dropbox and raster image errors in shinapps.io
